page.overview:
Who is Kaigaku?

Kaigaku was a former Demon Slayer and Zenitsu Agatsuma's senior disciple under the former Thunder Hashira, Jigoro Kuwajima. However, sometime during the Hashira Training, Kaigaku went on a mission and encountered Upper Rank One, Kokushibo, quickly surrendering to him to save his life and later becoming a demon.

As a human, Kaigaku was a muscular young man of average height and pale complexion. He had short, spiky black hair with two thick strands framing each sides of his face along with bangs at the front, and a pair of dull, cold teal eyes framed by thick, arched eyebrows. His expression was often unfriendly, and he had a semi-permanent snarl.

While training under Jigoro, Kaigaku wore a black kimono with a white collar. It was worn loosely to expose his chest and his pendants, which are decorated with gold magatama beads and a blue string. When he became a Demon Slayer, Kaigaku wore the Corps' standard uniform, which consisted of a navy gakuran-style button-up jacket, with a stand-up collar and long sleeves, featuring silver buttons and a shirt pocket on the left breast, with the kanji for |Metsu}} engraved on the back of the uniform. Beneath the jacket, he wore a white long-sleeved collared undershirt. His uniform also included a pair of matching navy tattsuke-hakama held up by a white belt, tucked into a black fabric of cloth wrapped around his ankles. On his feet, he wore navy tabi socks and a pair of zori sandals with bright blue straps.

After Kaigaku became a demon, he gained four navy blue flame-like markings on both sides of his cheeks, emerald green irises (originally colored cyan in the manga) with black sclera, elongated canines resembling fangs, sickly pale skin, sharp blackened nails, and pointed ears. By becoming a member of the Twelve Kizuki and rising to the position of Upper Rank Six, his eyes became etched with the kanji for |Jōgen}} on his right, and daiji of |Roku}} on his left. Kaigaku still retained his signature kimono, which was secured with a blue obi over a stylized version of his Demon Slayer uniform that has yellow flame-like markings near the chest area and an unbuttoned collar. His forearms are seemingly wrapped in white kyahan-like material, and he wears additional necklaces on his wrists. The magatama on his pendants are now blue instead of yellow, and have a light turquoise strings instead of blue.
